summary: Build a website for the user's business
architectural_notes: Authentication (if added) should use Internet Identity (passkey-based), not usernames/passwords.
Website/business name should be sourced from the centralized site configuration module and updated to "IQRA COMMUNICATION" so it propagates across all pages (header/footer/SEO where applicable).
Add the descriptor/tagline "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER" to the centralized site configuration so it can be rendered consistently across pages (e.g., hero, header/footer, SEO where applicable).

existing_features.title: Create a responsive business website frontend with a clear navigation header and footer, including these pages/sections with English placeholder copy that can be easily replaced later: Home (hero + value proposition + primary call-to-action), About, Services, and Contact.

Add a single, coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) applied consistently across the site; use a distinct style appropriate for a professional business website and avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette.

Make site content easy to update by centralizing the business name, tagline, service list, contact details, and social links in a single frontend configuration/module and rendering the UI from that data.

Implement the Contact form UX: client-side validation (required fields, email format), clear error messages, loading state, and a success confirmation state after submission (no external email/SMS integrations).
Add basic SEO and sharing defaults: set page title(s) and meta description (placeholder values) and ensure the site has sensible heading structure (one H1 per page/primary view).
Add the required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the UI (logo in header/footer; hero image/illustration in the Home hero).

Update the centralized site branding content to include the word "Singh" in the business identity shown across the site (e.g., business name and/or tagline), using the existing site configuration module as the single source of truth.
Add a login/logout control to the site header using the existing Internet Identity provider so visitors can sign in and sign out without usernames/passwords.
Ensure the mobile navigation experience also exposes the same sign-in/sign-out functionality so authentication is available on small screens.

Update the centralized site branding configuration so the website/business name displays as "IQRA COMMUNICATION" across the entire site (header, footer, and any page-level usage that reads from the configuration).
Update SEO defaults and page metadata so the browser tab title and meta description no longer reference the previous business name and instead use "IQRA COMMUNICATION" (keeping text in English).

Update the centralized site branding/content configuration so the phrase "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER" appears as part of the business identity shown across the site (preferably via the existing tagline field), and ensure the header and footer display the updated branding wherever they render values from the centralized configuration.

Update SEO defaults so the static HTML title and meta description include the updated branding ("IQRA COMMUNICATION" and "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER") and do not conflict with the centralized branding message.
